functional_findings: The raw-table-only NOAA CH4 reader returned the same selected raw values and digest with one GET; retain it for lower-request-count raw-only tasks and when the rendered page is unavailable or not needed.

The new comparator adds the rendered-page values and a direct contemporaneous page-versus-raw comparison, so the raw-only result cannot satisfy a task requiring both surfaces or detect a page/raw disagreement.
A mocked negative control changes the page's 2023 value from 8.29 to 8.30 ppb; the comparator reports a literal +0.01 ppb difference without ranking either surface.
The existing CO2 surface comparator addresses a different species and ppm contract; it cannot satisfy the methane/ppb task.

uncertainties: This one live matched capture showed exact agreement; it does not establish long-run page/raw agreement or comparative reliability.
Latency, service quality, monetary cost, statistical significance, source authenticity, and scientific validity were not compared.
